description: Show the site's container services: per-service status (ready, restarts, waiting or crash reasons, volumes), the stored config, the names of the site secrets that are set (never values) with the dashboard link where the user adds them, and optionally the recent logs of one service. Use get_app_status instead of get_site for anything about containers.

logs.description: Service name to include recent logs for (includes the previous crashed container if it restarted).

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: get_app_status
title: Show container service status and logs
